primary_sources.supports: For NTFS3.0/3.1, FILE_NAME contains a parent directory reference, counted Unicode name and filename flags. Name attributes relate a file to directory entries; their presence alone is not current-source membership proof.
An MFT reference includes low/high segment-number fields and a nonzero reused sequence. Zero sequence is reserved; preserving only the record ordinal loses identity information.

A referenced FILE header sequence must match its reference. The header distinguishes in-use and filename-index flags, and a base record has a zero base-file reference. These observations apply to the documented NTFS3.0/3.1 profile.
The reserved UpCase file supplies uppercase data used for filename collation. This page does not establish the complete disk-table format, matching algorithm or every per-directory case policy.

local_findings: Existing filename decoder preserves parent full reference, original UTF16LE name, namespace byte and opaque duplicated-information/suffix views. Reuse its checked bytes rather than a second parser.

The existing ordinary-stream joiner intentionally refuses multiple selected resident attributes. Enumerating filename attributes is a different responsibility: distinct filename/instance edges must not be collapsed into one resident data stream.
Directory index acquisition already binds its full directory reference, source/window/epoch, graph and retained bytes, while explicitly leaving target membership, collation and namespace unverified.
inferences_to_resolve_in_contract: Verify each index name edge against a source-context-bound, in-use target FILE with the exact full reference and required base/extension ownership, then its relevant filename attributes. Define multiple names, hard links and DOS aliases explicitly.
Keep exact original-name/parent/namespace membership separate from case-folded lookup and ordering. Do not compare opaque duplicated-information bytes as undocumented authoritative fields.
Acquire declared attribute-list dependencies under finite global quotas; collecting name attributes needs instance-aware enumeration rather than the single ordinary-stream API.
Define how source record/extension data is acquired and independently replayed before any native membership claim. Supplied-context assertions alone grant no source access.
